method: Period-5 cyclic pattern (ZDRGB) filled from other cycles
steps: Split into blocks of 5; each block is a rotation-free copy of Z D R G B
Blanks in order: Z, B, G, R, D
A fails (last D needed not B); C fails (first must be Z); D fails (third must be G)
All cars are birds gives Some birds are cars (I)
Some birds are plants gives Some plants are birds (II)
All plants are leaves with plants existing gives Some leaves are plants (III)
check_code:
import itertools
# regions over (car,bird,plant,leaf) membership; enumerate nonempty-region models
regs=[r for r in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4)]
def ok_region(r):
    c,b,p,l=r
    return (not c or b) and (not p or l)
regs=[r for r in regs if ok_region(r)]
res=[]
for mask in range(1<<len(regs)):
    S=[regs[i] for i in range(len(regs)) if mask>>i&1]
    if not S: continue
    if not any(r[1] and r[2] for r in S): continue
    # cars, plants, exist? assume all terms nonempty
    if not any(r[0] for r in S) or not any(r[2] for r in S): continue
    I=any(r[0] and r[1] for r in S);II=any(r[2] and r[1] for r in S);III=any(r[3] and r[2] for r in S)
    res.append((I,II,III))
assert all(x==(True,True,True) for x in res)
ans='B'
assert ans=='B' and ans!='A' and ans!='C' and ans!='D'

steps: Circles subset of balls; balls and toys overlap but circles need not overlap toys
Pits contains balls; not all pits are toys
check_code:
import itertools
regs=[r for r in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4) if (not r[1] or r[3]) and (not r[2] or r[3])]
# r=(ball,toy,circle,pit) ; circle->ball, ball->pit ; fix: index0 ball,1 toy,2 circle,3 pit
regs=[r for r in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=4) if (not r[2] or r[0]) and (not r[0] or r[3])]
cI=cII=True
for mask in range(1,1<<len(regs)):
    S=[regs[i] for i in range(len(regs)) if mask>>i&1]
    if not any(r[0] and r[1] for r in S): continue
    if not any(r[2] for r in S): continue
    I=any(r[2] and r[1] for r in S)
    II=all(r[1] for r in S if r[3])
    cI&=I;cII&=II
assert cI is False and cII is False
